name: CLOCKS_PER_SEC
intro: Expands to an expression (not necessarily a compile-time constant) of type std::clock_t equal to the number of clock ticks per second, as returned by std::clock().

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: POSIX defines CLOCKS_PER_SEC as 1'000'000, regardless of the actual precision of std::clock().
